item.title: How Can Data Integration Support AI Adoption in CPG Manufacturing?
item.description: AI is revolutionizing manufacturing with applications in predictive analytics and product development. Despite challenges like data silos and integration, progress is being made towards agentic AI. Discover how companies are adapting and what the future may hold.

item.title: B&G Foods Sells U.S. Green Giant Frozen Vegetable Product Line to Seneca Foods
item.description: B&G Foods previously sold the Green Giant U.S. shelf-stable vegetable product line to Seneca Foods in November 2023 and the Le Sueur U.S. shelf-stable vegetable product line to McCall Farms in August 2025.

item.title: Hain Celestial Sells NA Snacks Business to Canadian Snack Manufacturer
item.description: Hain Celestial says the divestiture sharpens the company’s focus and advances a simplified North American portfolio centered on core categories with stronger margin and cash flow profiles.

item.title: Kirin Launches Two RTD Cocktails in U.S.
item.description: Created with American consumers in mind, the new flavors bring Hyoketsu’s signature crisp, fruit-forward taste to two key U.S. markets.

item.title: How Continuous Mixing Supports Efficient and Sustainable Baked Good Production
item.description: The first continuous mixing systems were designed for low-volume production of stiffer doughs and products such as pretzels, crackers and bagels. But in the 30-plus years since, several kinds of continuous mixers have emerged to handle many distinct application challenges and all dough types.

item.title: VIDEO | Food Plant Openings and Expansions February 2026
item.description: EIC Alyse Thompson-Richards recaps some recent plant openings and expansions in the food and beverage industry, including Little Sesame’s new plant, InnovAsian’s frozen food facility, Charcuterie Artisans’ innovation center, BRIDOR’s expansion, M2 Ingredients’ innovation center and Boh Bah’s production facility.

item.title: Dainty Foods to Open Ohio Manufacturing Facility
item.description: The 250,000-square-foot facility will expand the company's production of rice and ready-to-heat meals in North America.

item.title: DrinkPAK Opens Beverage Manufacturing Facility in Texas
item.description: Completed by ARCO National Construction, the facility supports DrinkPAK’s expansion into North Texas and reflects a growing industry trend toward flexible, high-capacity contract beverage manufacturing.

item.title: Nestlé Purina Opens $481M Pet Food Facility in Brazil
item.description: The Vargeão site is Purina's largest investment in Brazil and will nearly double the company's wet pet food capacity in the country when fully operational.
